experiences.name: Sagrada Família Guided Tour
experiences.description: Explore Gaudí's iconic unfinished basilica with a guided tour that reveals the intricate symbolism, stunning stained glass, and architectural genius behind one of the world's most unique buildings. Book a tower access ticket for panoramic city views.

experiences.name: Palau de la Música Catalana Evening Concert
experiences.description: Attend a live concert at this UNESCO World Heritage modernista masterpiece designed by Lluís Domènech i Montaner. The stunning stained glass ceiling and ornate interior make this a breathtaking fusion of architecture and nightlife culture.

experiences.name: Gothic Quarter & El Born Architecture Walk
experiences.description: Self-guided or small-group walking tour through Barcelona's medieval Gothic Quarter and trendy El Born neighborhood, discovering Roman ruins, Gothic cathedrals, and modernista gems. End the evening bar-hopping through El Born's vibrant cocktail bars.

experiences.name: Montjuïc Pavilion & Poble Sec Tapas Night
experiences.description: Visit the iconic Mies van der Rohe Barcelona Pavilion, a landmark of modern architecture, then head to nearby Carrer de Blai in Poble Sec for an authentic pintxos and tapas crawl through some of Barcelona's best local bars as the night comes alive.

experiences.name: Razzmatazz Club Night
experiences.description: Experience Barcelona's legendary nightlife at Razzmatazz, one of Europe's most celebrated clubs housed in a converted industrial warehouse. With five rooms playing different music genres, it's a must for architecture lovers who appreciate repurposed industrial spaces and night owls alike.
